bad_pr.title: Add sized_iterator class
bad_pr.body:
### Issue reference
[more-itertools/more-itertools#1123](https://github.com/more-itertools/more-itertools/issues/1123)

### Changes
Adds a `sized_iterator` class that wraps around an _iterable_ and provides a `__len__` function for it.

This is useful when the length of an _iterable_ is known in advance but not supported by the iterable itself (e.g., a generator, a file, a database). This allows usage with tools that rely on ``len()``, such as progress bars.

```
>>> def my_generator(n):
...     for i in range(n):
...         yield f"Item{i}"
>>> gen = my_generator(3)
>>> sized_gen = sized_iterator(gen, 3)
>>> len(sized_gen)
3
>>> list(sized_gen)
['Item0', 'Item1', 'Item2']
```

fix_pr.title: Issue 1304: ichunked matches chunked for n=0 and negative n
fix_pr.body:
### Issue reference
more-itertools/more-itertools#1304

### Changes
`ichunked` is documented as being like `chunked`, but a nonempty iterable with `n=0` called `islice(iterator, -1)` and raised islice's `ValueError`. Negative `n` leaked the same islice message instead of `n must be at least 0`.

Treat `n=0` as an empty iterator (without consuming the source) and reject negative `n` the same way `chunked` does.

### Checks and tests
- `python -m unittest tests.test_more.IchunkedTests` — OK
- `python -m unittest` — 932 tests OK
- `ruff check more_itertools/more.py tests/test_more.py` — OK
- `ruff format --check more_itertools/more.py tests/test_more.py` — OK
